changelog:
• Fixed hero trailers not playing on the Firestick — the app was picking a 160kbps Opus audio track that Fire TV cannot reliably decode. It now prefers H.264 video and AAC audio, which the Firestick decodes in hardware
• If a stream still will not decode, the trailer retries on a single maximum-compatibility stream before giving up
• Phone hero buttons no longer squash into unreadable stubs — Play and Trailer keep their labels, the rest are icons
